online.name: online.member.<n>.name_key
online.summary: The text key of a member's name when it has none of its own.

online.name: online.member.<n>.icon
online.summary: The member's profile icon id, or empty when it has not sent one.

online.name: online.member.<n>.host
online.summary: Whether the member hosts the room.

online.name: online.member.<n>.ready
online.summary: Whether the member is ready.

online.name: online.member.<n>.local
online.summary: Whether the member is the player at this machine.

online.name: online.member.<n>.arriving
online.summary: Whether the member's seat is taken while its connection is still being set up.

online.name: online_open
online.summary: The rooms screens opened: the list is asked for.

online.name: online_close
online.summary: The rooms screens closed.

online.name: online_refresh
online.summary: Asks for the room list again.

online.name: online_field
online.summary: The text field that takes the keyboard: filter, code, name, or empty for none.

online.name: online_filter
online.summary: Replaces the room search's text.

online.name: online_code
online.summary: Replaces the code field's text.

online.name: online_profile_name
online.summary: Replaces the name being typed on the profile screen.

online.name: online_profile_save
online.summary: Keeps the typed name as the profile's (notice name_empty when nothing is left).

online.name: online_profile_icon
online.summary: Changes the profile's icon.

online.name: online_profile_relay
online.summary: Connects the next rooms through the server's relay only (true) or directly (false).

online.name: online_retry
online.summary: Asks again for the room last asked for (hosting, joining from the list or by code).

online.name: coop_host
online.summary: The co-op lobby's: opens a room this player hosts, true public (listed), false private (by code only).

online.name: online_join
online.summary: Joins a listed room by its id.

online.name: coop_join
online.summary: The co-op lobby's: joins a room by the code given (without one it opens the lobby's code entry).

online.name: online_join_code
online.summary: Joins a room by the code typed in the code field.

online.name: online_quick
online.summary: Joins the first open room of a playable mode, or answers online.quick none.

online.name: online_mode
online.summary: The host picks the room's mode.

online.name: coop_ready
online.summary: The co-op lobby's: the guest marks itself ready, or not when it was.

online.name: coop_start
online.summary: The co-op lobby's: the host starts the room's game.

online.name: online_open_to_join
online.summary: The host says whether its game, once under way, takes new players (true, the default) or only guests coming back.

online.name: online_leave
online.summary: Leaves the room (the host closes it).

online.name: online_dismiss
online.summary: Clears the notice, the quick match's answer and a room that closed.

online.name: online_sample
online.summary: Switches to the sample rooms and back (only with the developer tools on).

online.name: online.state
online.summary: The screens' state: open, sample, sample_offered, field, filter, code, code_length, quick, notice, notice_key and can_retry.

online.name: online.profile
online.summary: The player's online profile: name, named, icon, wins, losses, draft and relay_only.

online.name: online.icons
online.summary: The icons a profile can pick: id and label_key.

online.name: online.list
online.summary: The room list: state, error, error_key, total and the rooms matching the filter (id, code, name, message, host_name, state, mode, mode_key, players, capacity, ping, ping_level, full, in_progress, joinable).

online.name: online.modes
online.summary: The game modes: id, label_key, description_key, short_key, available and selected.

online.name: online.room
online.summary: The room the player is in, or nil: code, name, host, listed, phase, phase_key, mode, mode_key, capacity, error, error_key, detail, can_start, can_ready, ready, in_progress, open_to_join, coop_difficulty, coop_difficulty_key and members (name, icon, host, ready, local).

online.name: online.error_key
online.summary: The text key of an error code; unknown codes give online.error.unknown.

online.name: online.notice_key
online.summary: The text key of a notice code.

online.name: online.open
online.summary: The rooms screens opened.

online.name: online.close
online.summary: The rooms screens closed.

online.name: online.refresh
online.summary: Asks for the list again.

online.name: online.edit
online.summary: The text field that takes the keyboard: filter, code, name or nil.

online.name: online.set_filter
online.summary: Replaces the room search's text.

online.name: online.set_code
online.summary: Replaces the code field's text.

online.name: online.host
online.summary: Opens a room: public (listed) or private (by code only).

online.name: online.join
online.summary: Joins a listed room.

online.name: online.join_by_code
online.summary: Joins a room by a code, or by the typed one.

online.name: online.quick_match
online.summary: Joins the first open playable room, or answers quick = none.

online.name: online.set_mode
online.summary: The host picks the room's mode.

online.name: online.set_ready
online.summary: The guest marks itself ready or not.

online.name: online.start
online.summary: The host starts the game.

online.name: online.set_open_to_join
online.summary: The host says whether its game, once under way, takes new players or only guests coming back.

online.name: online.leave
online.summary: Leaves the room.

online.name: online.set_name_draft
online.summary: Replaces the name being typed on the profile screen.

online.name: online.save_name
online.summary: Keeps the typed name as the profile's.

online.name: online.set_icon
online.summary: Changes the profile's icon.

online.name: online.set_relay_only
online.summary: Connects the next rooms through the server's relay only, or directly when possible.

online.name: online.dismiss

online.name: online.set_sample
online.summary: Switches to the sample rooms and back.

online.name: online.changed
